title: Text input field not editable with non-click focus
body:
### Tested versions

Happens in godot 4.4.

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable (49a5bc7b6) - Fedora Linux 42 (Workstation Edition) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 4 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU - AMD Ryzen 5 5600H with Radeon Graphics (12 threads)

### Issue description

Building a keyboard controllable interface with a mixture of buttons and LineEdits. When I use arrow keys to get focus on a text field, I can't type in the field. Using the mouse to click on the text field works of course, but that's not fully in the spirit of the keyboard interface. The tab key can actually get focus on text fields that allows for typing, but that involves making the user break away from the arrow key paradigm used for the rest of menu navigation, which is a bit undesired. Typing focus can also be gained by pressing enter, then beginning to type, but it's not immediately intuitive. It would be nice if the behavior were to allow for typing whenever the text field gains any kind of focus. This might be classifiable as a proposal, though I do strongly feel like the current behavior is quite undesirable.

### Steps to reproduce

Slap togethor a scene with a mixture of buttons and text fields, set neighbours for focus navigation if needed and call grab_focus() and attempt to navigate to the text fields with arrow keys and type.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[inputexample.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20190264/inputexample.zip)
